title: Line Sisters: A Deadly Reunion
description: Four sorority sisters reunite for a weekend celebration on the Outer Banks of North Carolina. However, a deadly secret from the past soon threatens to tear them apart as strange and inexplicable things begin to happen.

title: Dead on Campus
description: A nerdy and introverted guy is seduced by a sorority pledge, and their tryst goes viral. When he is found dead from an apparent suicide, his sister does not believe he killed himself, and investigates the sorority's dark secrets.

title: Homekilling Queen
description: Whitney Manning, gorgeous, entitled and deranged daughter of wealthy and equally disturbed Connie, is determined to become homecoming queen and absolutely nothing will stand in her way.
